summary: SEALSQ Corp filed a Form 6-K announcing a majority investment in Wecan Group, increasing its stake from 28% to a majority position. The transaction includes a CHF 5 million strategic commitment from SEALSQ's Quantum Fund to accelerate development of a post-quantum AI compliance co-pilot for financial institutions. No per-share price, premium, or board recommendation is disclosed. SEALSQ plans to integrate post-quantum cryptography and secure hardware. The deal aims to provide financial institutions like Pictet and Barclays with quantum-resistant compliance solutions. Watch for regulatory approvals and integration milestones.
